Forward_Facing_Binocular_Eyes.description: Emerging from the sockets of this lupine predator’s skull, these forward-facing binocular eyes pierce through the darkness with a predatory gleam, their keen vision granting unparalleled accuracy and heightened perception, locking onto targets with deadly precision.

Tapetum_Lucidum_Night_Lenses.description: Enveloped in a supernatural glow, the Tapetum Lucidum Night Lenses are canine eyes adapted for the hunter's moon, granting unparalleled night vision that pierces through the veil of darkness, enhancing both perception and accuracy in the shadows.

Pale_Staring_Husky_Irises.description: Pale, haunting irises that seem to stare into the depths of one's soul, these icy orbs belong to a spectral husky, their cold gaze granting a chilling resistance to frost and a sharp, perceptive wisdom.

Bulbous_Lateral_Pug_Eyes.description: Bulging and round, these pug-like eyes bulge from the sides of the cephalon, granting heightened perception to detect subtle movements and threats in the dimly lit caverns, yet their protruding nature slightly impairs accuracy in aiming at distant targets.

Cybernetic_Targeting_Optics.description: Brimming with cold, calculating precision, the Cybernetic_Targeting_Optics are canine-like ocular implants that pierce the veil of darkness, enhancing the user's accuracy and perception to devastating effect, granting them the skills to lock onto and strike down their foes with unparalleled efficiency.

Spectral_Ghost_Hound_Orbs.description: Emerging from the spectral visage of a canine undead, the Spectral Ghost Hound Orbs burn with an otherworldly intelligence, granting their fabled bearer heightened wisdom and a keen, ethereal perception that pierces the veil between realms.

Nictitating_Membrane_Aquatic_Shields.description: Equipped with a translucent nictitating membrane, this canine's cephalon is adapted for aquatic traversal, enhancing its vision and agility beneath the waves, while granting improved perception and accuracy in water, along with the ability to perform a swift Swim Dash maneuver.

Infernal_Burning_Hellhound_Eyes.description: Infernal Burning Hellhound Eyes blaze with an otherworldly crimson glow, their pupils narrow slits that reflect the eternal flames of the underworld, bestowing upon their owner a fearsome visage that can strike terror into the hearts of foes and a natural aura of searing heat that chars the air around them.

Multiple_Arachnid_Like_Ocelli.description: Embedded within the creature's fleshy, mutated cephalon are multiple arachnid-like ocelli, glistening with a chitinous sheen, granting it unparalleled perception and accuracy, as if it can see through the shadows and react to the slightest movements with eerie precision.

Blind_Subterranean_Vestigial_Orbits.description: Deep within the shadowed recesses of the earth, these vestigial orbits, remnants of once keen canine eyes, now serve as hollow, sightless sockets, their presence a testament to the harsh realities of subterranean existence, granting the bearer an eerie sense of awareness through echolocation and vibrations, yet robbing them of the clarity and precision granted by true vision.
